conversations.answer: ChatGPTREADMEWorking Set:The working set consists of three JavaScript files:generateHandler.js: This file exports an async function generateHandler which processes an HTTP request, checks if the repository is clean, processes the prompt, and sends the response back.startInteractiveSession.js: This file exports an async function startInteractiveSession that handles an interactive session with the user, processes a prompt, and checks if the user wants to send it.processPrompt.js: This file exports an async function processPrompt which creates a prompt and writes it to a file.Task:The primary task is to refactor the existing code:Rename processPrompt to generatePrompt in both the filename and function name.In startInteractiveSession, rename the task variable to notes.Challenges:Ensuring all references to the old names (processPrompt and task) are updated correctly.Creating a shell script that makes these changes without using sed, and instead opting for full file re-creation using heredocs.[CODE_BLOCK_0]Note: Ensure to backup your data and test this script in a controlled environment before running on actual data.
